exposure: abnormal umbilical cord insertion in the second twin (velamentous or marginal)
cohort: 455 women pregnant with twins (307 dichorionic and 148 monochorionic) who attempted vaginal delivery
finding: Abnormal umbilical cord insertion in the second twin (velamentous or marginal) was significantly associated with umbilical cord prolapse during delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that 89.5% of twin pregnancies where vaginal delivery was attempted resulted in vaginal delivery of both twins.
